project: JHS GLOBAL Admin Suite - Step 10: Company Profile, Founders & System Settings

userStories.title: Team Users, Roles (RBAC) & Security Administration API & UI
userStories.description: Implement administrative staff user management API and Desk UI with role-based access control, active status toggles, and session security
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/admin/users returns paginated list of staff users with role badges, active status, and last login timestamps
POST /api/v1/admin/users creates new staff user with bcrypt-hashed password and assigned role (admin, sales, editor, viewer)
PUT /api/v1/admin/users/:id updates user details and role with audit trail logging
PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/:id/toggle-active toggles user status with self-lockout prevention
POST /api/v1/admin/users/:id/reset-password securely resets password and invalidates session token
Users.jsx renders full enterprise Desk with DataTable, FilterBar, user avatar badges, and slide-over AdminDrawer for user provisioning
RBAC strictly enforces admin-only access; sales and editor receive 403 Forbidden

userStories.title: Compliance & Security Audit Trail Desk UI
userStories.description: Build comprehensive Compliance & Security Audit Trail desk UI connected to immutable backend audit log repository
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/audit-logs returns chronological administrative mutations with pagination and filters (entityType, action, userId, date range)
Audit snapshot data sanitizes sensitive keys (password, token, secret, auth) with [REDACTED]
AuditLogs.jsx renders enterprise activity ledger with DataTable, FilterBar, staff badge, action pills, entity badges, and IP/browser metadata
Slide-over detail drawer or modal shows formatted before/after JSON diff with visual change highlights
Access restricted to admin role only

userStories.title: Company Profile, Founders & System Health Desk UI & API
userStories.description: Deliver single source of truth Company Profile, Founders dossiers, masked trade finance, and live system health diagnostics API and UI
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/admin/settings/company-profile returns canonical corporate identity (JHS GLOBAL, Surat, founders, ports, statutory licenses, contact channels)
PUT /api/v1/admin/settings/company-profile updates company profile with audit log and cache invalidation
GET /api/v1/admin/settings/system-health returns PostgreSQL connection pool health, pgvector extension status, table counts, uptime, and memory usage
POST /api/v1/admin/settings/cache-flush flushes server memory cache with audit log
Settings.jsx renders 4-tab enterprise desk: Corporate Profile & Legal Identity, Founders & Leadership Dossiers, Bank & Trade Finance (masked), and System Health & Database Diagnostics
Official brand JHS GLOBAL and founder Jay Sureshbhai Prajapati strictly enforced; unverified facts marked TODO(client)

userStories.title: Automated Step 10 Test Coverage & Zero Public Regression Gate
userStories.description: Verify Step 10 implementation with automated backend test coverage and proof-of-no-change visual regression testing across all 5 viewports
acceptanceCriteria: Admin API client in client/src/admin/api.js provides fetchAdminUsers, createAdminUser, updateAdminUser, toggleAdminUserActive, resetAdminUserPassword, fetchAdminAuditLogs, fetchCompanyProfileSettings, updateCompanyProfileSettings, fetchSystemHealth, and flushServerCache
Automated integration tests in server/tests/settings-admin.test.js cover user management, audit logs, company profile settings, system health diagnostics, and RBAC rejection
Full backend test suite (9 test suites) passes 100% with no-file-parallelism
Zero visual and DOM regression across all 5 viewports (360px, 390px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px) confirmed via verify:no-change
